feeds.title: valantic Blog » E-Commerce
feeds.description: Valantic creates software and digital process solutions that enable customers to achieve strategic advantages over their competitors. Their aim is to break through established thought patterns. They combine technological expertise with industry know-how. They overcome the central challenges of digitalization with a uniquely flexible, elementary organizational structure and operational excellence. Find out what opportunities e-commerce offers and how you can optimize your electronic commerce in their blog.

feeds.title: Speed4Trade Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2005 by company owners Sandro Kunz and Stefan Sommer, Speed4Trade is a digital platform with a focus on the automotive aftersales market. Their vision is to help companies become closer to customers through digital solutions. With future-oriented and high-performance platform technologies, they connect companies more closely with their customers. Their blog provides news about the company, software solutions for B2B and B2C commerce, current and upcoming trends, and more.

feeds.title: E-commerce Germany News
feeds.description: E-commerce Germany News is a website featuring articles, news, interviews, and case studies about the e-commerce industry in Germany. They write about big players and startups, cross-border, omnichannel, online shop platforms, logistics, payments, marketing, IT solutions, and more.

feeds.title: eClear News
feeds.description: Founded in Germany in 2016, eClear is the only VAT and Customs Clearing House in Europe. With its innovative automation solutions, retailers overcome the complexity of transactional taxes in Europe and accelerate their cross-border B2C and D2C business. Its solutions transform the handling of VAT and customs duties from the ground up. With their latest news and articles, they inform about European e-commerce as well as VAT, customs, and compliance.

feeds.title: Exciting Commerce
feeds.description: As an independent industry companion, Exciting Commerce has been providing information about new markets and future-oriented business models in e-commerce since 2005. It is dedicated to business innovation in e-commerce. It (dis)covers new business models and exciting new e-commerce companies. Go through its blog to discover what ll e-commerce market has to offer.

feeds.title: Lemundo Blog
feeds.description: Lemundo is your e-commerce agency for sustainable growth in Hamburg & Stuttgart. Digital/online marketing & e-commerce platform as well as online shop development from a single source. Real full-funnel, full-service agency with a dedicated team. For B2B and D2C manufacturers or brands, it offers everything from a single source from E-Commerce consulting to the conception, design, and implementation of an E-Commerce platform to strategy and implementation of Full-Funnel Online Marketing. Head straight to their blog for helpful articles about e-commerce.

feeds.title: ecosistant Blog
feeds.description: As a tech startup and consulting agency located in Berlin, Ecosistant is the node point between recycling schemes and e-commerce sellers. They develop digital solutions to dismantle trade barriers of international e-commerce and to make recycling accessible to everyone. Their digital consulting service assists the compliance-management of e-commerce businesses and links them with the best recycling schemes. Browse the blog to learn more about the circular economy, packaging- and product compliance, CSR, and other topics related to sustainability in e-commerce.

feeds.title: Etailment
feeds.description: Etailment is a digital commerce magazine from 'Der Handel' that caters to e-commerce entrepreneurs and individuals aspiring to become one. It offers reliable support and strengthens medium-sized companies in their operational and strategic activities. The magazine provides industry-relevant facts, tips, trends, analysis, and other information related to the e-commerce market.

feeds.title: Actindo Blog
feeds.description: From unified commerce to digitization topics and more, the Actindo Blog is regularly updated with industry news, trends, and tips for an expert audience. They provide a comprehensive, composable solution to brands, retailers, and manufacturers who wish to leverage omnichannel commerce and delight their customers.

feeds.title: SUNZINET Blog
feeds.description: SUNZINET is the first port of call for ambitious companies for the economically successful management of digital change. With their pioneering spirit, they create outstanding user experiences and are home to a passionate team. They further develop the business model of their customers through sustainable digital solutions. Their agile teams work in close cooperation along the business objectives for efficient and outstanding results. Explore the blog for articles on e-commerce.

feeds.title: Handelskraft
feeds.description: Since 2006, dotSource has been developing and implementing scalable digital products for marketing, sales, and services. Whether e-commerce and content platforms, customer relationship and product data management, or digital marketing and business intelligence, more than 500 digital natives see themselves as partners for their customers, whose individual requirements are incorporated from the first idea. Go through Handelskraft blogs and read articles on e-commerce platforms, marketing strategies, industry insights, latest technologies, news, and updates.

feeds.title: E-Commerce Institute Cologne
feeds.description: The E-Commerce Institute Cologne is a research department, which develops business management concepts and solutions for e-commerce companies based on scientific research. Its mission is to actively help and support the development and implementation of digital, future-oriented, and sustainable e-commerce projects based on empirical research and application-related studies with and for companies. Their blog covers articles about digital buying and selling, e-commerce, online trading, online shops, shop systems, shop applications, and more.

feeds.title: Snafu Blog
feeds.description: Snafu supports companies with innovative hosting & network services. They have been providing care since 1994. They analyze the market, competition, and target group. Follow the Snafu Blog and read articles on business strategies, case studies, e-commerce management, shop performance analytics, technological updates, industry news, and more.

feeds.title: Beyond E-Commerce Blog
feeds.description: Beyond E-Commerce helps companies transform their digital business, conquer scalable opportunities, and tackle operational challenges. Access to an ever-growing knowledge database on e-commerce, building & scaling digital business models. Follow the intriguing Beyond E-Commerce Blog Discover informative articles about e-commerce, business growth, industry knowledge, news, and more.

feeds.title: E-Commerce Magazin
feeds.description: E-Commerce Magazine is a specialist magazine for e-commerce that informs industry and trade analysts about new business models and trends in logistics, e-payment, and sales on the Internet.

feeds.title: K5 - Future Retail
feeds.description: Located in the beautiful city of Munich, K5 GmbH specializes in digital trade/e-commerce. They offer the largest and most relevant streaming platform carefully selected all year long. With a talented team of around 20 employees, they design, produce, and market their weekly K5 TV stream, as well as the K5 PODCAST formats Cheftreff, Commerce Cast, and Female in Retail. Check out their informative blog for more information on their services, previous work experience, industry insights, latest news, and updates.

feeds.title: Warehousing1 Blog
feeds.description: Warehousing1 is a LogTech startup from Berlin-Kreuzberg. Their goal is to sustainably improve the entire fulfillment experience for e-commerce brands. They provide commerce customers with comprehensive fulfillment services through an international network of first-class logistics locations. Whether procurement logistics, production logistics, or distribution - they support you with short-term interim storage through to complex contract logistics solutions. Explore the blog for articles and insights on e-commerce.

feeds.title: PVS Europe Blog
feeds.description: PVS is one of the market-leading owner-managed e-commerce fulfillment companies. With over 30 years of experience, they have expertise in a wide range of industries and can therefore provide you with targeted support with insider know-how as well as a securely positioned partner network. In their blog, they regularly inform you about news on the topics of e-commerce, fulfillment, marketplaces, logistics, and more.
